svg.text: It shows what glucose does to the liver, eyes and kidneys, and lets you test a change before trying it on the real patient.
Open + synthetic data only · Decision support
change a meal, walk, sleep or medicine
see the new glucose curve and organ risk
Explainable · calibrated uncertainty · safety rules in code · served by one REST API
the log becomes the doctor's adherence diary
every action is written to the audit trail
Kaya is decision support for clinicians, not a diagnostic device. All patients are synthetic. Models, metrics and frameworks are on the next page.
Team Kaya · IIT Hyderabad · Digital Twin Challenge, Phase 1
